### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Arize Phoenix is Arize's open-source AI observability platform designed for experimentation, evaluation, and troubleshooting. For managed production workflows, Arize also offers [Arize AX](https://arize.com/products/ax/). Phoenix provides: - [**_Tracing_**](https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/tracing/llm-traces) - Trace your LLM application's runtime using OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation. - [**_Evaluation_**](https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/evaluation/llm-evals) - Leverage LLMs to benchmark your application's performance using response and retrieval evals. - [**_Datasets_**](https://arize.com/docs/phoenix/datasets-and-experiments/overview-datasets) - Create versioned datasets of examples for e
